data.name: StepsIntro
data.value: A cycle runs each time a candle closes on the agent's timeframe.

data.name: StepReconcileBody
data.value: The agent checks its positions and orders against Binance.

data.name: StepCollectBody
data.value: It gathers market data and computes indicators.

data.name: StepAnalyzeBody
data.value: The Technical Analyst and Sentiment Analyst work in parallel.

data.name: StepProposeBody
data.value: The Strategist turns both analyses into a trade, or holds.

data.name: StepChallengeBody
data.value: The Risk Critic approves, modifies or rejects the proposal.

data.name: StepEnforceBody
data.value: The Risk Engine sizes the order and applies hard limits. AI output can't bypass it.

data.name: StepExecuteBody
data.value: The order goes to Binance, or waits for your approval in Confirm mode.

data.name: TermsOfUseService
data.value: Ecnanib is a free tool for running automated trading agents on your own Binance account. It is offered as is, and it may change or stop at any time.

data.name: TermsOfUseResponsibility
data.value: You are responsible for your agents and for every order they place. You are also responsible for being eligible to use Binance where you live, and Ecnanib does not check this.

data.name: TermsOfUseCredentials
data.value: You bring your own exchange and AI provider keys, and you pay those providers for what you use. Your exchange keys must not have withdrawal permission.

data.name: TermsOfUseChanges
data.value: If these terms change in a way that matters, you will be asked to accept them again before you continue.

data.name: RiskDisclosureLoss
data.value: Trading crypto assets can lose you some or all of your money, and leverage can lose it faster. Only trade what you can afford to lose.

data.name: RiskDisclosureAutomation
data.value: AI models make mistakes, and rule checks limit losses without preventing them. Markets, exchanges and this service can all fail at the worst moment.

data.name: RiskDisclosureNoAdvice
data.value: Nothing in Ecnanib is financial advice, and Ecnanib is not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance.

data.name: RiskDisclosureDemo
